primary_heldout_result: candidate BEATS incumbent on H4 held-out families: SR 0.000->0.333, SPL 0.000->0.333, NE 14.04->5.02 m, nDTW 0.167->0.411 (n=6)
prior_heldout_result: candidate REGRESSES vs incumbent on prior held-out uturn/chain/ftL: SR 0.167->0.000, OSR 0.667->0.333, SPL 0.167->0.000; NE improves 12.76->8.15 m (n=6)

candidate: h4_navgen_diversity retained as non-promoted positive evidence
reason: This is the H-track's first measurable held-out transfer (not the H3-clean tie), but it is within-navgen-distribution cross-family transfer with a regression on the older held-out families. Promotion requires resolving the cross-distribution regression (e.g. joint/mixed-family training or replay) and a combined held-out non-regression, plus human adjudication.

claim_boundary: Because H4 uses a fixed placeholder goal image, this result is not evidence of stronger goal-image conditioning. It is evidence about route-family-diverse scripted imitation under the current hospital pipeline.
human_adjudication_recommendation: DO NOT PROMOTE; hold as positive diagnostic; decide next: mixed-family retrain vs accept as diagnostic-only

human_confirmation.decision: do not promote H4; hold as positive diagnostic; incumbent retained

final_adjudication_text: H4 is a positive diagnostic result, not a promoted model. It supports the hypothesis that route-family diversity matters, because the candidate improves strongly on the new held-out H4 families. It also shows that fine-tuning only on the new H4 family distribution causes older-family regression. Therefore, the incumbent remains the H1 hospital fine-tune. The H4 candidate is retained as non-promoted evidence.
